title: Withholding Tax for Employee
summary: Withholding tax support for employee transactions has been added, allowing users to calculate and track employee-related withholding taxes similar to existing purchase-based functionality with new employee setup tables, calculation logic, and ledger entries.
key_points: New employee withholding tax setup: groups, group lines, threshold period, calculation base and method enums, and a threshold accumulator
New employee withholding calculation codeunit and posting subscribers
Employee card, employee ledger entry and Withholding Tax Entry extended for employee withholding
New Expense Withholding Tax app extends expense categories, tax posting setup and threshold accumulator
Gen. Jnl.-Post Line updated in all localization layers, and permission sets include the new objects
